items.goal: Add a 'Surprise me' link to the catalog filters panel that opens a random product from the currently filtered list, chosen on the server at click time through a new /surprise route in WebApp.
items.modelReason: Small Blazor SSR change with a redirect route; normal work.
items.verifyReason: Visible link and navigation flow on the catalog page.

alternatives.option: Compute a random product id at render time and put it in the link's href
alternatives.reason: The pick would be fixed for that page load and needs extra item fetches; a click-time server route keeps each click random.
Widens scope to Catalog.API and its OpenAPI documents; the existing paged API with pageSize 1 is enough.
